description: This PHP test file contains unit tests for the OAuthClientDao class, which handles CRUD operations related to OAuth clients within the OrangeHRM system. It tests creating, retrieving, counting, and deleting OAuth client entities and verifies their properties.

classes.name: OAuthClientDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the functionality of the OAuthClientDao class, including CRUD operations for OAuth clients, using the OrangeHRM testing framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of OAuthClientDao and loading fixture data from YAML.

methods.name: testSaveOAuthClient
methods.description: Tests the saveOAuthClient method by creating a new OAuthClient instance, setting its properties, saving it, and asserting the saved values.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of OAuth clients and verifies the properties of returned entities.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientCount
methods.description: Verifies the counting functionality for OAuth clients.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientById
methods.description: Tests fetching an OAuth client by its ID, including a non-existent ID returning null.

methods.name: testGetOAuthClientByClientId
methods.description: Tests fetching an OAuth client by its client ID, including an invalid ID returning null.

methods.name: testDeleteOAuthClients
methods.description: Tests deletion of OAuth clients by IDs and verifies the remaining entities.
